questions.prompt: The usual mistake with a donk bet is…

choices.text: Leading a weak pair into a range that has the advantage.
Folding air to a large bet
Calling a small bet with a flush draw

questions.explanation: Donk bets announce a hand and fold out the bluffs you wanted to catch.

questions.prompt: Check-raising air on every flop fails because…

choices.text: You are out of position on later streets when you get called.

questions.explanation: A raise that gets called leaves you playing a big pot first to act with nothing.

questions.prompt: Which line matches a medium pair out of position against a small bet?

choices.text: Check-call, and fold if later bets get too large for the hand.
Fold to any bet including the minimum
Donk pot on the flop before they act

questions.explanation: Small bets can be called by hands that beat air. Large later bets are a new price.

questions.prompt: You check-raised the flop and got called. On a blank turn with no pair, you should…

choices.text: Slow down more often. The call means you are behind a lot.
Bet only if you can fold out a better hand you do not block

questions.explanation: One raise did not turn air into the nuts. Barrels need a new reason.
